components.note: 亻 (person) — marks people and their actions, as in 你, 他, 做; 侮 is to insult a person.
每 (měi) is only a loose sound hint for wǔ.
辱 (rǔ) — to humiliate; as a part it sounds out 褥 rù and 溽 rù.
山 (mountain) — marks hills and heights, as in 岛 island, 峰 peak, 崖 cliff; 岸 is a steep bank or shore.
干 (gān) is a loose hint for àn.
雨 (rain) — marks weather and moisture, as in 雪, 雷, 雾; 露 is dew.
路 (lù) gives the sound exactly: 露 lù (dew) or lòu (reveal).
纟 (silk thread, from 糸) — marks cloth and cords, as in 线, 红, 约; 绅 is a sash, worn by gentlemen.
申 (shēn) gives the sound exactly: 绅 shēn, also in 神 shén and 伸 shēn.
虫 (insect) — a picture of a crawling worm; as a radical it marks insects and creepy-crawlies, as in 蚊 mosquito, 蜘 spider, 蛇 snake.
皿 (dish) — marks vessels, as in 盒 box, 盖 lid, 盆 basin; 盘 is a plate.
舟 (boat) here stands in for 般 (bān), which hints at pán, as in 搬 bān.
鸟 (bird) — marks birds, as in 鸭 duck, 鹅 goose, 鸽 pigeon; 鸡 is a chicken. 又 only replaces the old sound part.
歹 (bone, death) — marks death and decay, as in 死 die, 殆; 残 is damaged or cruel.
戋 (jiān) is a loose hint for cán; it appears in 钱 qián, 浅 qiǎn and 线 xiàn.
氵 (water) — marks water and sinking, as in 海, 没 sink, 游; 沉 is to sink.
冗 (rǒng) is only a loose sound hint for chén.
黑 (black) — marks darkness, as in 墨 ink, 黯 dim; 默 mò (silent) sounds like 墨 mò, with 犬 dog quietly following.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk, as in 说, 语, 讲; 详 is a full account, in detail.
羊 (yáng) hints at the sound: 详 xiáng is close, as in 祥 xiáng and 洋 yáng.
仓 (cāng) — granary; as a part it sounds out 苍 cāng, 沧 cāng and 舱 cāng.
广 (building) — marks halls and shelters, as in 店, 座, 床; 库 is a storehouse, here for carts 车.
吉 (jí) — lucky; as a part it sounds out 结 jié and 洁 jié.
山 (mountain) — a picture of three peaks; as a radical it marks hills, as in 岛, 峰, 岸.
酉 (wine jar) — marks wine and brewing, as in 酒, 醉 drunk, 醒; 配 first meant mixing wine, then matching.
己 (jǐ) is only a loose sound hint for pèi.
禾 (grain) — marks grain and crops, as in 秋, 种, 租; 称 originally meant weighing grain, then naming (称呼).
衤 (clothing) — marks cloth, as in 衬, 衫, 裤; 补 is to mend a garment.
卜 (bǔ) gives the sound exactly: 补 bǔ.
亻 (person) — marks people and their actions, as in 你, 做, 借; 偿 is to repay.
尝 (cháng) gives the sound exactly: 偿 cháng.
忄 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 情, 快, 怕; 忏 is remorse.
千 (qiān) is only a loose sound hint for chàn.
虫 (insect) — marks insects and bugs, as in 蚊, 蛇, 蝴; 蜘蛛 is a spider.
知 (zhī) gives the sound exactly: 蜘 zhī.
虫 (insect) — marks insects and bugs, as in 蚊, 蛇, 蝴; 蜘蛛 is a spider.
朱 (zhū) gives the sound exactly: 蛛 zhū, also in 珠 zhū and 株 zhū.
犭 (animal) — marks animals, as in 猫 cat, 猪 pig, 猴 monkey; 狗 is a dog.
句 (jù) is a loose hint for gǒu; 够 gòu and 钩 gōu share it.
氵 (water) — marks rivers and water, as in 河, 海, 江; 汉 is the Han River, which gave name to the Han dynasty and people.
土 (earth) — marks earth and ground, as in 地, 城, 墙; 堡 is an earthen fort.
保 (bǎo) gives the sound exactly: 堡 bǎo.
奏 (zòu) — to play music; as a part it sounds out 揍 zòu and 凑 còu.
宀 (roof) — a house, as in 家 home, 安 safe, 完; 富 is a house full of goods, hence rich.
畐 (fú) gives the sound: 富 fù is close, as in 福 fú and 副 fù.
寸 (hand, inch) — a hand, as in 对, 寻, 守; with 圭 (a heap of earth) it means heaping earth to mark a border, then to seal.
贝 (shell, old money) — marks money and trade, as in 财 wealth, 货 goods, 贵 expensive; 赚 is to earn.
兼 (jiān) is only a loose sound hint for zhuàn.
阝 (hill, from 阜) — marks slopes, as in 阶 steps, 院, 陆; 降 is to go down a slope.
夅 (two feet going down) — shows descent, and gives the sound: 降 jiàng.
手 (hand) — marks hand actions, as in 拿, 打; 摩 is to rub with the hand.
麻 (má) gives the sound: 摩 mó is close, as in 魔 mó and 磨 mó.
女 (woman) — with a hand 又, a seized person: a slave. 奴 nú also sounds out 努 nǔ and 怒 nù.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wood, as in 林, 树, 桥; a village among the trees.
寸 (cùn) hints at the sound: 村 cūn is close.
艹 (plants) — marks grasses and herbs, as in 花, 草, 茶; 苏 originally named the perilla plant, and is also short for Jiangsu and Soviet (苏联).
詹 (zhān) — mostly a surname; as a part it sounds out 瞻 zhān and 蟾 chán.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿, 脑; 肩 is the shoulder.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿; 膀 is the upper arm or shoulder.
旁 (páng) is a loose hint for bǎng; 榜 bǎng and 磅 bàng share it.
将 (jiāng) is the trimmed top part: 奖 jiǎng sounds like 桨 jiǎng and 浆 jiāng.
力 (strength) — marks effort, as in 动 move, 努 strive, 办; 励 is to urge on.
厉 (lì) gives the sound exactly: 励 lì.
买 (simplified 買) — the old form shows a net 网 over a shell 贝 (money): netting goods, to buy. 卖 mài sell is built on 买.
手 (hand) — marks hand actions, as in 拿, 打, 拉; 擎 is to hold up, as in 引擎.
敬 (jìng) is only a loose sound hint for qíng.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿, 脑; 膝 is the knee.
桼 (qī) is a loose hint for xī; 漆 qī shares it.
皿 (dish) — marks vessels, as in 盘, 盒, 盆; 盖 is a lid, a cover over a vessel.
阝 (hill, from 阜) — marks walls and slopes, as in 院, 阶, 附; 隔 is to separate with a partition.
鬲 (gé) gives the sound exactly: 隔 gé.
